name: Neotame
aliases: E961, neotame, Newtame, high-intensity sweetener neotame, flavour enhancer neotame
what_is: A high-intensity non-nutritive sweetener that can also be used as a flavour enhancer and is effective at very low use levels.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because E961 is a high-intensity sweetener with specific authorised conditions of use that vary by jurisdiction.
can_1: Identify E961 or neotame when declared on the label.
can_2: Trigger the E-number and sweetener information layers.
cannot_1: Determine the concentration used from its position in a standard ingredient list.
cannot_2: Determine total dietary exposure or make an individual health judgement from the presence of neotame alone.

sources.label: FDA — Aspartame and Other Sweeteners in Food
EU specifications for authorised food additives — Regulation (EU) No 231/2012
